title: Betis
summary: Raleigh names Betis in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Betis, a faithfull seruant to Darius, who defended Gaza, also called Babemesis, whom Alexander drew about the streets. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter II, §. VI, sig. 473a
